_note: Provider list prices in US dollars per million tokens, checked 2026-11-05. BILLING_MARKUP_PERCENT is added on top. A model not listed here can't be used while billing is on. Where a provider has peak/off-peak, promo or long-prompt rates, the higher standard rate is used so you never undercharge.
